subject: Customer-driven retention matrix and evidence request (MedSecure)
messages:
From: Brian Soto <brian.soto@medsecure.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: Dr. Priya Menon <priya.m@medsecure.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Retention for tenant-scoped debug logs + evidence request

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo last week — the product looks promising. For our legal and security review we need a clear picture of your data lifecycle for tenant-scoped debug/audit logs when using Redwood Private (VPC). Two asks from our InfoSec team: 

1) A customer-specific retention matrix (per-log type) showing default TTL, retention if under legal hold, and how a tenant-level deletion request is executed (expected time-to-delete and evidence delivered).
2) The CAIQ/SIG pages you can populate that map to the retention controls (we only need the retention-related questions and any artifacts).

We have a hard deadline to complete SOC 2 preparatory materials by 2026-10-22. Can you provide a proposed matrix and supporting artifacts (or an estimate for delivery)?

Also, one additional constraint: we will require a sample proof-of-delete for a tenant export (manifest + checksum) — how long does it take to produce that for a single tenant in a typical AWS-hosted Private deployment?

Appreciate a quick turn.

Best,
Brian
Brian Soto
Head of InfoSec
MedSecure AI

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Brian Soto <brian.soto@medsecure.ai>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-18T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Retention for tenant-scoped debug logs + evidence request

Hi Brian — thanks for the clear list. We're happy to help and can deliver the matrix and evidence you're asking for. High-level answers up front: 

- Default TTLs vary by artifact: session traces (30d default), transient debug snapshots (7d default), audit trails (365d default). All are configurable per-tenant in Redwood Private.
- Legal or customer-directed holds suspend deletion and create a preservation snapshot; we can produce a manifest + sha256 checksums for exported/deleted objects. Typical turnaround for a single tenant proof-of-delete is 2 business days (routine) — can be expedited to same-day for an elevated SLA.
- For CAIQ/SIG mapping we have a retention-focused extract; I will attach the SIG excerpt and a starter retention matrix for your review.

Attached: retention-matrix-medsecure.xlsx (starter), SIG-answers-medsecure.pdf (retention pages only). We'll also export the CAIQ retention snapshot as a zip and upload to the Drive once we're aligned on scope.

Quick question for scoping: do you want the matrix to include per-region keystore residency and a separate column for on-disk encrypted vs. ephemeral in-memory traces? That will change the level of detail and time required.

I propose we do an alignment call today or tomorrow — I have a 2:30pm PT slot if that works.

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Brian Soto <brian.soto@medsecure.ai>, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-18T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Retention for tenant-scoped debug logs + evidence request

Hi Brian — adding a few engineering details to clarify how deletion works in Private deployments (so the matrix fields map to implementation):

- Tenant deletion is a two-phase workflow: (1) soft-delete + retention tombstone (allows recovery for N days configurable) and (2) physical erase (object rewrite + re-key and block-level tombstone) per your configured TTL. Our control plane issues the physical erase job to the worker fleet.
- Proof-of-delete artifacts we can produce: deletion manifest (list of object ids), export snapshot (tar with objects removed), verification checksums (sha256), and a signed timestamped statement from our custodian service.
- For ephemerals (e.g., KV cache, in-memory attention cache) those are zero-persist by default but snapshots may be taken for debugging if enabled. We log snapshot creation and can include those entries in the manifest.
- Keystore residency: if you require keys to remain in your HSM or KMS, we support customer-managed KMS with envelope encryption; residual metadata stored by Redwood is minimal and can be scoped out.

Attachments: none here — Kim has attached the starter matrix. For the CAIQ export, we will filter to retention-related questions (e.g., SI-xx, OP-xx).

If helpful, I can prepare a short runbook that maps the matrix row -> API call / operator job name so your auditors can reproduce the verification. That would add one extra day.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Principal Applied Security Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Brian Soto <brian.soto@medsecure.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: Dr. Priya Menon <priya.m@medsecure.ai>, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-18T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Retention for tenant-scoped debug logs + evidence request

Kim/Neha — thanks, this is helpful and addresses a lot of the questions. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Please include a column in the matrix for "time-to-complete proof-of-delete (business hours)" and one for "artifacts produced".
- Yes, include keystore residency per-region — our procurement will insist on explicit KMS residency statements for EU vs US.
- We would like the runbook mapping row -> API/operator job; that'll make the auditor review straightforward.

We can take your 2:30pm PT slot today to walk through the starter matrix — I'll invite Priya and one of our auditors. If you can expedite same-day proof-of-delete estimates (i.e., whether 2 days is the routine SLA) that would help our SOW draft.

Brian

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Brian Soto <brian.soto@medsecure.ai>, Dr. Priya Menon <priya.m@medsecure.ai>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-19T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Retention for tenant-scoped debug logs + evidence request

Thanks Brian — good alignment in today's call. Action items and deliverables we committed to: 

1) Finalized retention matrix (per-log-type + columns for time-to-complete proof-of-delete, artifacts produced, keystore residency) — delivery: 2026-10-19 EOD. (attachment: retention-matrix-medsecure.xlsx)
2) Runbook mapping matrix row -> API call/operator job (PDF) — delivery: 2026-10-20 EOD.
3) CAIQ snapshot filtered to retention-related questions and our exported SIG pages (attachment: SIG-answers-medsecure.pdf + caiq-snapshot-20261018.zip) — delivery: 2026-10-19 EOD.
4) Sample proof-of-delete: engineering will stage a one-tenant proof-of-delete in our Private staging cluster and provide manifest + checksums. Estimated time-to-produce: ~18 hours from job start; standard turn is 2 business days. If you need this sooner we can commit to 6 hours for an expedited run (will require an elevated SLA request).

Next steps: I'll upload the artifacts to the Drive links below and raise a HubSpot ticket linking the SOW checklist so procurement can see the timelines. If you need anything else (e.g., signed attestation), let me know and we'll scope it in.

Best regards,
Kim

Attachments referenced above: retention-matrix-medsecure.xlsx, SIG-answers-medsecure.pdf, caiq-snapshot-20261018.zip
